metadataAuthority: Original PNG prompt metadata; exact historical prompts and seeds, not the revised planning prompts.

historicalPromptNotes.note: The source PNG used the old phrase 三个楚地少年 and also explicitly 蒙眼少女. Current art constraint is 三个孩子; 雩 remains a girl with her blindfold intact.
The source PNG used an invented age 40–50. The revised planning prompt removes that number; the script calls him 老人. Do not treat the historical prompt age as story canon.
